messages:
tyler: quick heads-up: found a deterministic ESM/CJS interop failure that breaks our sample-app edge builds (vite/rollup/webpack -> Cloudflare/Vercel Edge). repro + notes below. assigning triage.

angelica: can you paste the minimal repro and the exact runtime error?

tyler: minimal repo: https://github.com/redwood-repros/edge-interop-repro (branch: edge-repro). package.json uses conditional exports: {
  "type": "module",
  "exports": { ".": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" } }
}
Dist mjs exports both named + default. CJS build ends up only exposing default in some bundler transforms, so runtime: "TypeError: Redwood.createClient is not a function" or "(0, _redwood__WEBPACK_IMPORTED_MODULE_0__.createClient) is not a function" depending on bundler. Dev server (vite) usually fine.

rob: seen this. root cause is mismatched interop between our CJS artifact and how bundlers rewrite imports/require. Edge runtimes don't provide Node interop shims, so built bundles fail.

angelica: mitigation we shipped in sample-apps: consumer-side `import * as Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'` or `const r = require('redwood-sdk').default || require('redwood-sdk')`. Packaging fix: add small CJS shim file and point exports.require to it. e.g. dist/interop-require.cjs:
const m = require('./index.cjs'); module.exports = m?.default ?? m;

rob: bundler hints for docs: vite -> optimizeDeps.include + transformMixedEsModules=true; rollup -> plugin-commonjs requireReturnsDefault:'preferred'; webpack -> mark package as javascript/auto and resolve.fullySpecified=false for module.

tyler: also a typings mismatch: our index.d.ts currently has both `export default` and named exports which confuses TS consumers without esModuleInterop. suggestion: add a cjs-compatible .d.ts (export =) or ship namespace-style d.ts for CJS.

ci-bot: created issue #4890 to add bundler-matrix CI (vite/rollup/webpack x node18/20 x cloudflare/vercel) and added a packaging unit test asserting that `typeof require('redwood-sdk').createClient === 'function'`.

tyler: plan: ship shim in patch release, add docs cookboook, and deprecate CJS in a future major. assigning rob to CI and angelica to docs.

angelica: will write cookbook snippets and sample-app updates.

rob: will add CI job and try to reproduce minimal failing bundle for each bundler.

tyler: thanks all. drop any new error strings here if you hit them.
